    AI Overview
    Federal income taxes for the 2025 tax year are due on April 15, 2026. This deadline applies to filing returns, paying any taxes owed, and submitting extension requests. If you cannot file by this date, you can request an automatic six-month extension, pushing the filing deadline to October 15, 2026. 
    Key 2026 Tax Deadlines: 
    • April 15, 2026: Deadline to file tax returns (or extension) and pay taxes owed.
    • October 15, 2026: Extended deadline to file tax returns.
    • Extension Disclaimer: An extension grants more time to file paperwork, not more time to pay taxes owed. 
    Quarterly Estimated Tax Payments (If applicable): 
    • Q1: April 15, 2026
    • Q2: June 15, 2026
    • Q3: September 15, 2026
    • Q4: January 15, 2027 
    If you live in a state with income tax, state deadlines generally match the federal April 15 deadline, though some states vary. You can pay or request an extension directly through the IRS website.

    What happens if I file my taxes after April 15th?
    Failure-to-file penalty: for individual taxpayers, this penalty is 5% of your unpaid taxes for each month (or partial month) that your taxes stay unpaid, capping off at 25% of the total balance due. (WSJ) Failure-to-pay penalty: 0.5% of the unpaid balance each month up to 25% of the total balance due.
